AV03.rule: Refine each SCF/grid/atomic-grid family separately; compare two finest levels with other families fixed sufficiently fine.
AV03.origin: Quanta predeclared engineering acceptance, not source-certified uncertainty

AV05.rule: Engine all-electron hard+soft integral compared to 2.
AV05.origin: Quanta predeclared engineering acceptance, not source-certified uncertainty

AV06.rule: Explicit full hard+soft electron-number density export: integral rho*dV compared to 2, including field/grid refinement.
AV06.origin: Quanta predeclared engineering acceptance, not source-certified uncertainty
AV06.blocked_until: A02/A04 full-density export semantics pinned; soft or signed total charge density cannot substitute

selection: Check all ten ordered finer-reference comparisons using unchanged AV03/AV05/AV06 and the 0.001 electron limit separately for each of the 4-point, 6-point and Fourier L1 values.
Each measured row must use the prescribed distinct even native lattice, the centered He geometry and a converged SCF. Each passing pair must pass both QZ overlap and 1 Å native boundary shell checks.
An eligible candidate needs at least two distinct finer measured lattices. The candidate must pass against every finer tested lattice, and the two finest references must pass against each other.

Among eligible candidates rank by observed engine wall seconds, peak cgroup RAM, peak cgroup swap and then cutoff. These are individual isolated host observations, not a controlled performance benchmark.

A pair-level pass without the finer-lattice confirmation does not qualify a candidate. This screen does not execute F2 through F4, establish basis convergence, freeze a profile, or qualify public or OCI execution.
